title: Planning Administrator

description:

This could be a great opportunity to join a busy and established company close to Bolton town centre. With a busy team of 12 engineers working across the region, they're looking for an experienced Planning Administrator who can hit the ground running and help keep everything organised.

What will you be doing as a Planning Administrator?
Working with large organisations across the North West, the company looks after everything from ongoing maintenance contracts and repairs through to new installations and large-scale rollouts. The role will include:
- Planning and scheduling routes for a team of engineers working across the North West
- Organising routine maintenance visits as well as reactive customer call outs and allocating work
- Taking calls from customers regarding faults, repairs, maintenance and new installations
- Booking jobs and updating the database
- Managing a busy and changing workload, constantly reviewing priorities throughout the day
- Working closely with engineers to make sure they have the information and work they need
- Speaking with customers, dealing with problems and finding practical solutions when plans change

What's in it for you?
- A salary of 29,000 to 31,000 salary, depending on experience
- The chance to ear bonus twice a year
- Holidays that increase over time to 25 days plus bank holidays
- On-site gym
- Free car parking
- Company pension scheme
- A fantastic and friendly team to work with
- Good career prospects

Why would you join this company?
This is a genuinely busy business with a strong customer base across the North West, so you wont be sitting around waiting for the phone to ring.

The planning team plays an important part in keeping the engineers, customers and wider business running smoothly. You'll have plenty to get involved with from day one and will be working in a role where your ability to organise, prioritise and solve problems really makes a difference.
What were looking for
- Previous experience in a planning, scheduling or coordination role, involving engineers or other similar field-based teams
- Good geographical knowledge of the North West
- Confident dealing with customers and engineers over the phone
- Good problem-solving skills
- Good general IT skills
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail

The practical stuff
Salary: 29,000- 31,000

- Potential for the hours to be split between two part-time people, with shifts of 8am-1pm and 1pm-6pm

- Free on-site parking
- The opportunity to work within a prestigious luxury car dealership and gain valuable experience in a premium customer-facing environment

Why would you join this company?

You'll be joining a large, modern luxury car dealership where customer experience is at the heart of everything they do.
This is a great opportunity to work in a professional, smart environment, meeting a wide variety of customers and playing an important part in making sure every visitor receives a positive experience from the moment they arrive.

What we're looking for

- Previous customer-facing experience, ideally within Reception, Front of House, Hospitality or Customer Service
- Confident telephone manner and experience answering calls and dealing with customer enquiries
- A friendly, outgoing and approachable personality
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to interact with customers face-to-face

Previous experience within a car dealership would be advantageous but is not essential. We're particularly interested in people who enjoy hospitality, meeting customers and making sure everyone receives a first-class welcome.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: An opportunity has arisen to join our well established, friendly but very busy team as a part-time receptionist. We are looking to recruit an enthusiastic, motivated Receptionist to work within our friendly Surgery for 20 hours per week over 4 days. The surgery is looking for a highly motivated, hardworking individual with excellent customer service and communication skills. You will need very good organisational skills, have the ability to prioritise and work under pressure with initiative. You will also need to be flexible and able to cover holidays/sickness as and when required. Excellent IT skills are required. We currently use EMIS Web computer system. Knowledge of EMIS is preferred but not essential as training will be provided. A GP receptionist plays an important role in ensuring the smooth running of a GP surgery and providing a friendly, professional service to patients. Main duties include welcoming patients, answering telephone calls, booking, cancelling and rearranging appointments, and responding to general enquiries. Receptionists register new patients, update personal details and maintain accurate medical records. They handle patient information confidentially, following GDPR guidelines and practice policies. They also process prescription requests, pass on paperwork and direct enquiries to the appropriate healthcare professional. A GP receptionist must recognise potentially urgent requests and follow practice procedures to ensure patients receive timely attention. They communicate effectively with GPs, nurses and other members of the practice team to support patient care. Other responsibilities include sorting post, managing correspondence, updating computer systems and keeping the reception area organised. They must remain calm, polite and compassionate, especially when dealing with anxious or upset patients. Overall, a GP receptionist helps ensure the practice runs efficiently while providing patients with a professional, respectful and supportive service. Job description Greets patients in a friendly and courteous manner at all times. To answer telephone calls in a polite and professional manner. To make appointments for the doctors surgeries and nurses clinics using the Practice clinical information system To ensure that surgeries and clinics run on time, making sure that the doctors and other clinicians are aware of their schedules. Answering patients non clinical queries To open the post, and distribute accordingly. To arrange new patient registrations, explaining the surgery policies. To listen to patient complaints, making sure that they are addressed and dealt with appropriately. To retrieve patients medical records for various clinics and surgeries. To file patients records in the correct manner. To check and update patients addresses, telephone numbers etc, on both manual and computerised records. To scan all hospital correspondence accurately. To create new patients medical records. Culling & tagging of all new medical records To provide secretarial cover in the absence of the practice secretary. To cover duties for other members of staff, this may arise in the case of absence, sickness and holidays. Chaperone GP if required. To ensure that the surgery in which you are working is left secure after use at all times during your work hours and ensuring Practice premises and perimeters are left secure at the end of the day. Shared responsibility for reception, waiting rooms and consultation rooms upkeep and tidiness including leaflets and posters To ensure that strict confidentiality protocols are adhered to. Attending and contributing to practice meetings. To attend training sessions on behalf of the practice as required. To comply with health & safety procedures and report any areas of concern to the Practice Manager. To undertake any other duties as may be determined from time to time to ensure the efficient running of the practice.
